title: Gilbert Bigio, Haitian Tycoon Linked to Gangs, Dies at 91
summary_full: Reportedly the wealthiest man in the poorest country in the Western Hemisphere, Gilbert Bigio was sanctioned for ties to criminal gangs. He was 91.
